description: This file contains functions for managing device-specific features on I-O DATA devices, especially involving reading/writing bytes to MTD devices, setting flags, and preparing the environment in a Linux-based embedded system.

methods.name: iodata_mstc_prepare_fail
methods.description: Handles failure in environment preparation, logging a message, unmounting all filesystems, and forcing a reboot.

methods.name: iodata_mstc_rw_byte
methods.description: Reads or writes a single byte in an MTD device at a given offset, depending on whether a value to set is provided.

methods.name: iodata_mstc_set_flag
methods.description: Sets a specific flag in an MTD device for I-O DATA devices by reading the current flag, validating it, and updating if necessary.
